document_notes: Page 213 of PIR, containing the continuation of the entry for C. Arrius Antoninus (PIR² A 1088).

entries.relevance_notes: Explicitly attested as Legatus Aug. pr. pr. Cappadociae and Legatus Aug. pr. pr. co(n)s(ularis) trium Daciarum.

segments.identification_and_sources: Fronto ad am. 2,7 p. 192 N. = 2 p. 176, 1 Haines; 2,8 p. 199 N. = 2 p. 188 Haines; Tertull. ad Scap. 5; vita Pert. 3,7; vita Comm. 7,1.
segments.offices_and_career: Consul suffectus a. fere 170. Legatus Aug. pr. pr. Cappadociae. Legatus Aug. pr. pr. co(n)s(ularis) trium Daciarum. Proconsul Asiae c. a. 184/185. Curator Ariminiensium, curator Nolanorum, curator Tifernatium Tiberinorum. Augur, sodalis Marcianus Antoninianus. Patronus Concordiensium, patronus IIII coloniarum (Cirtensium).
segments.governorship_attestation: Legatus Aug. pr. pr. Cappadociae t. 9—11 preses (sic) p(rovinciae) t. 11 ante a. 175 vel eo ipso anno t. 11... Legatus Aug. pr. pr. co(n)s(ularis) trium Daciarum t. 2. 6. 7; leg. Aug. pr. pr. t. 4.
segments.family_and_social_relations: Calpurnia Quadratilla uxor. C. Arrius Antoninus, C. Arrius Quadratus filii. Cornelius Fronto (whom he observed as a parent).
segments.prosopographical_commentary: Discussion of his governorships of Cappadocia and Dacia, his proconsulship of Asia and the persecution of Christians mentioned by Tertullian, his accusation by Pertinax, and his death under Commodus due to Cleander's plots.
segments.bibliography_or_cross_references: Cumont (Studia Pont. 3, 119); Daicovici I. l.; Waddington Fast. As. n. 157; Heer Philol. Suppl. 9, 80 sq.; Haines.

relations.basis: Cornelium Frontonem non secus quam parentem observavit
